text:
maya: heads up — onboarding issue: sample app fails in Cloudflare Workers with 'process is not defined' when using sdk v2. Any quick fixes?

jordan: yep seen that. Cause: our CJS bundle pulls in 'process' from node polyfill. Workers don't have Node globals.

maya: We're shipping an npm package that has both 'main' (cjs) and 'module' (esm). People using wrangler seem to pick cjs. Any guidance?

sam: short term: recommend ESM-only entrypoint for edge builds + provide a tiny shim in examples. long-term: we should update SDK to avoid node-only deps at runtime.

jordan: we could add an exports map so bundlers pick the worker-safe build. e.g.:

```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```

maya: example apps can't include that much build config — new users keep running into miniflare errors. Is there a simple polyfill we can suggest?

liam: tried adding `globalThis.process = { env: {} }` in edge entry — made miniflare happy but feels hacky and brittle.

jordan: also crypto usage: avoid `require('crypto')` or `import 'node:crypto'`. Use WebCrypto (`globalThis.crypto`) on workers. We can detect runtime: `const webcrypto = globalThis.crypto ?? fallback`.

sam: action items: (1) add a top-level `workers` field in package.json that points to a worker-ready bundle; (2) update quickstart + wrangler example that sets `bundle.nodeCompat: false` / esbuild target to `es2020`; (3) release a patch with an ESM-only dist and swap usage of `process.env` -> `globalThis.__REDACTED_ENV__` wrapper.

maya: I'll draft a PR for README + sample fix. cc @jordan for exports map PR. Anyone volunteer to validate on real Cloudflare account?

jordan: :raised_hands: I'll test on my personal account later today.

ci-bot: ci/build 1938765435: artifact for pr/123 built and uploaded.

liam: one more thing — TS types: users see "Cannot find module" when using types/exports. Ensure `types` field points to `dist/esm/index.d.ts` and our rollup/esbuild produces d.ts.

maya: noted. I'll include that in the README patch and add a tiny troubleshooting section: "If you see 'process is not defined' -> use ESM worker bundle or add the globalThis shim (not recommended for prod)".

jordan: also maybe add a test matrix job that runs the example on miniflare + real workers so we catch regressions in CI.

sam: agreed. I'll file a follow-up ticket and assign owners.

maya: thanks team — will post PR links here when ready.
